title: Change Order Approval Cycle Time
dataSources: Schedules (`reno:gantt`), punch lists (`reno:punchlist`), photo logs (`reno:photo`), permits (`reno:permit`), project controls (`reno:ops`).
app: Home-renovation project telemetry — Gantt plans, punch-list updates, inspection photo logs, and permit expiry trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via builder-tool exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reno:ops change_type=* requested_epoch=* approved_epoch=*
| eval lag_days=round((approved_epoch-requested_epoch)/86400,1)
| stats avg(lag_days) as avg_lag_days, max(lag_days) as worst_lag_days by change_type
| sort - avg_lag_days
description: Measures approval cycle time by change type for change orders.
value: Lag tracking shows which change type create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside change orders.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `approval cycle time` on `reno:ops` events and aggregate them by `change_type`.
visualization: Table of change type with average and worst approval cycle time.
grandmaExplanation: It blends how long things take for each change type so you can see where change orders slows down.
